text: It's a pity that Taiwanese aboriginal songs are rich and various yet there are only a few musical instruments. I found a few and compare them with the ones from Southeast Asia. We all know that twin-pipe nose flutes are only found in Taiwan, and they exist in Paiwan and are documented in Tsou's literature. The Austronesians in Southeast Asia have single-pipe nose flutes instead of twin-pipe nose flutes.
